Great experience
Jun 2024 • Friends
We visited this restaurant over the weekend with a family friend. The food served was exceptional, and I have shared some photos for you to view. The staff were attentive, accommodating, and courteous throughout our dining experience. Our dinner was part of a resort package; however, I was impressed by the high quality they maintained despite it being complimentary. Situated next to the beach, we felt compelled to sample their unique dishes such as the "Sentinel Crab stir-fried with garlic chilly salt." They allowed us to select our own crab ensuring its freshness! I wholeheartedly recommend this resort to all my family and friends as it offers great value for money.
